create.name: Amy Elizabeth Bost
create.bio:
Amy Elizabeth Bost is a Christian chaplain, preacher and writer who for most of her career was known as Amy Bost Henegar. Her first post was as a chaplain in a Los Angeles hospital; she later served for many years as a minister at a Church of Christ congregation in Manhattan. She earned a Doctor of Ministry at New York Theological Seminary, and in 2019 she gave the featured lecture of Pepperdine University's William M. Green lecture series. The gospel stories of Jesus, and especially the way he treated women and people pushed to the edges, sit at the centre of her preaching and writing.

Today she offers pastoral conversations about the life of the soul, coaching for people trying to discern a sense of calling during a change of season, small cohorts for those rebuilding their faith after old certainties have fallen away, and a preaching workshop for women. She also designs weddings, baby blessings, memorials and other rites for families of any faith or none, on a pay-what-you-can basis. During 2020 she recorded a daily morning prayer in modern, inclusive language, following a simple liturgical pattern with a changing scripture reading; those recordings remain free to hear on Insight Timer and as a podcast.

courses.title: Pastoral Care and Coaching for Calling
courses.description: One-to-one conversations by Zoom or phone about faith, hopes and the direction of your life, booked through her online calendar. Coaching sessions of 30 to 45 minutes help people work out where they feel called during a time of transition, and she also runs a faith-rebuilding cohort and a preaching workshop for women.

courses.title: Rituals by Amy
courses.description: She works with families to shape personal ceremonies for weddings, new babies, memorials, house blessings and other turning points. She can use the religious language that matters to you or simpler language drawn from nature and art, and she sets fees on a pay-what-you-can basis after a first conversation.

free_resources.title: Amy Elizabeth Bost on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A set of short spoken morning prayers in the Christian tradition, each with a scripture reading and a prayer focus in modern, inclusive language. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: As the Day Rises to Meet the Sun: Morning Christian Prayers
free_resources.description: The podcast home of the daily prayers she recorded through 2020. Each episode follows the same short liturgy with a different reading, so listeners can pray along at the start of the day.

free_resources.title: Lest the Rocks Cry Out (Pepperdine lecture recording)
free_resources.description: An hour-long recording of the lecture she gave at Pepperdine University's Stauffer Chapel in August 2019 as the featured speaker of the William M. Green lecture programme. Free to stream from the university's archive.
